title: For a founder
reader: a co-founder of a small company building its product with agents
judges: Is the speed claim believable, and is this something a five-person company can copy?
why_you: You build with agents on a small team and no spare hours. If this reads like luck rather than a method you could copy on Monday, you are the reader who will notice.

questions.q: What happened at 18:44, in your own words? Did the page make it clear?
Did the day read to you as speed, as luck, or as something else?
Where did the page lose you, if anywhere?
Would you want a button like this in your own team? What would make you hesitate?
Could you start this on Monday from what the chapter gives you? Where would you get stuck first?
Which step looks worth it for a team of five, and which looks like overhead?
What did you want to know that is missing: cost, hours, tools, failure?
What would you copy as it is, and what would you change?
